{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Trans-Union Interstate Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Sharon Hub, Claiborne Parish, Louisiana to Union County, Arkansas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2000-02-10/pdf/00-3045.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Trans-Union Interstate Pipeline LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2000-02-10/pdf/00-3045.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''427 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''41.7 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2000-02-10/pdf/00-3045.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''30 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2000-02-10/pdf/00-3045.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''1999<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2000-02-10/pdf/00-3045.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$45,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
